exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Present perfect for ongoing situations

items.prompt: We ___ clean returns for seven years.
items.hintAfterError: Situação que começou no passado e continua: have + particípio.

items.prompt: The tax authority ___ us fairly since then.
Our relationship with the tax office ___ good for a long time.
items.hintAfterError: Com 'for a long time' e situação que continua, use o present perfect.

items.prompt: A ___ correction shows the authority that we act in good faith.
We have ___ answered every request on time.
